subject: Observability add-ons: archival compression credits & dashboard seat model
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@avatech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — packaging questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Ava Tech is excited about Redwood's retention and tracing features. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we prep procurement:

- Can you outline a pricing example that combines 12 months of retention (50 TB ingest/year), tracing (hotpath + coldstore), and the advanced dashboards (seat-based)?
- We saw references to "compression credits" in the docs — how are those applied and can they be used to offset peak-month overages?
- Do you offer any ramp or promotional discounts on the dashboard seats for the first quarter?

I've attached a usage snapshot for the last 6 months to help with sizing. Ideally we'd like a clear PSO-style example (monthly billing cadence) and any contract caveats.

Attachments: AvaTech_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 86 KB)

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Infrastructure
Ava Tech

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Marta Lopez <marta@avatech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — packaging questions

Hi Marta — thanks for the snapshot, that's really helpful. High-level proposal below; attaching a short draft (proposal_v1.pdf) so you can circulate with procurement.

Summary offer (12-month commitment):
- Retention + Tracing: 50 TB/year ingest mapped to telemetry slab tier 3; baseline price $0.018/token-equivalent per ingestion unit.
- Archival compression credits: apply to coldstore archival, 30% effective cost reduction on archived bytes for eligible months; credits consume before overage invoicing.
- Advanced dashboards: seat-based at $55/seat/month standard; offer a 20% seat discount for the first 90 days for customers on a 12-month commit.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoice, net-30. Credits applied as line-item discounts on monthly bill.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal alignment: Ben to confirm concession range for compression credits and whether we can stretch the 30% to 35% on a 50% commit.
2) Legal/Proc: we'll send a draft contract + DocuSign link once pricing is locked.

I'm looping in Laura (pricing) and Ben (solutions) to finalize numbers. If that matches your expectations we can ship a signing-ready doc by Thursday.

Attachments: proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons — packaging questions

Jonas / Ben — quick internal note on levers we can use for Ava Tech: 

- Compression credits: we can increase to 35% for the first 6 months if they commit to the tier 3 slab (50 TB/year). After month 6 revert to 30%. This is a time-limited concession and should be captured in the SOW.
- Seat model: instead of percent discount, propose a seat-bucket structure: first 20 seats at $42/seat/mo for 90 days, additional seats at standard $55. That simplifies procurement ask and avoids per-seat pro-rates.
- Retention overage smoothing: offer a 10% buffer for the first 3 invoice periods before overage billing — helps them during ramp.

If Ben approves the above, we can push the DocuSign with those explicit clauses and clarify archival export SLA (48 hours) — legal will want 72 hours max unless they pay for expedited export.

Laura Bennett
Senior Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Marta Lopez <marta@avatech.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Updated offer: Ava Tech observability bundle (incl. credits & seat buckets)

Marta — happy to confirm the updated offer based on your usage snapshot and Laura's levers. Please see the key commercial points below. I also included the internal thread excerpt for context.

Commercial summary (final):
- Commitment: 12 months; mapped to telemetry slab 3 (50 TB/year).
- Archival compression credits: 35% credit applied to archived bytes for months 1-6, 30% months 7-12. Credits applied before calculating overage fees.
- Dashboard seat buckets: first 20 seats at $42/seat/month (90 days), thereafter $55/seat/month.
- Overage smoothing: 10% buffer for first 3 invoices; standard overage thereafter.
- Export SLA: standard 72 hours; expedited export (48 hours) available as paid add-on.
- Billing: monthly, net-30.

DocuSign link (draft contract w/ concessions): https://www.docusign.com/transaction/XYZ123
Proposal (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-proposal
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3245/DEAL-9051

Forwarded for transparency:
> On Tue, 11 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700, jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> Summary offer (12-month commitment): Retention + Tracing: ... Archival compression credits: 30% effective cost reduction ... Advanced dashboards: 20% seat discount for first 90 days ...

Ask: can you confirm acceptance of the export SLA trade (72 hrs standard) and commitment by end of week so we can lock pricing and send a signing-ready DocuSign? If you need a minor SLA tweak we can add expedited export as an add-on line item.

Attachments: AvaTech_contract-docusign.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta@avatech.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated offer: Ava Tech observability bundle (incl. credits & seat buckets)

Ben — this looks good.

We accept the commercial summary as written. Two small asks before signing:
1) Can you confirm the archival export process includes a one-time free expedited export in month 1?
2) Please add an explicit examples table to the SOW showing how compression credits affect a 600 TB coldstore snapshot (for our finance team).

If you can add those two items to the DocuSign, procurement will sign today. Please proceed.

Best,
Marta
Head of Infrastructure, Ava Tech
